scripts.check: biome check apps packages tooling tests docs .github README.md CONTRIBUTING.md package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml turbo.json biome.json vitest.parity.config.ts && pnpm check:architecture && pnpm check:guidance && pnpm check:test-structure && pnpm check:current-contracts
scripts.check:ci: biome ci apps packages tooling tests docs .github README.md CONTRIBUTING.md package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml turbo.json biome.json vitest.parity.config.ts && pnpm check:architecture && pnpm check:guidance && pnpm check:test-structure && pnpm check:current-contracts
scripts.dev:clean:
pnpm exec kill-port 3000 3001 8081 8082 || true && pnpm run self-host:down >/dev/null 2>&1 || true && printf '[dev-clean] local web/mobile dev servers and Supabase stopped
'
scripts.lint: biome lint apps packages tooling tests docs .github README.md CONTRIBUTING.md package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml turbo.json biome.json vitest.parity.config.ts
scripts.lint:fix: biome lint --write apps packages tooling tests docs .github README.md CONTRIBUTING.md package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml turbo.json biome.json vitest.parity.config.ts
scripts.format: biome format --write apps packages tooling tests docs .github README.md CONTRIBUTING.md package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml turbo.json biome.json vitest.parity.config.ts
scripts.test: pnpm test:workspaces && pnpm test:parity && pnpm test:architecture && pnpm test:security:query-string
scripts.test:architecture: node --test tooling/architecture/check-architecture.test.mjs tooling/architecture/check-guidance.test.mjs tooling/qa/profiles.test.mjs tooling/qa/prepare-runtime-web-e2e.test.mjs tooling/testing/parity.test.mjs tooling/testing/planner.test.mjs tooling/testing/structure.test.mjs tooling/e2e/stop-servers.test.mjs
scripts.test:parity: pnpm exec vitest run --config vitest.parity.config.ts && pnpm parity:report
scripts.quality:agent:static: pnpm check:generated && pnpm check && pnpm check-types && pnpm test && pnpm knip
